headline: Techera wins Rs 8.63 Cr GSE order from private space firm
summary: Techera Engineering secures Rs 8.63 crore work order for ground support equipment structures. Order value is ~17% of FY26 revenue. Backlog conversion and margin stability are key watchpoints.

headline: KDDL Q2FY27: Revenue up 31.6%, Eigen grows 50%
summary: KDDL Ltd reported a 31.6% YoY rise in consolidated revenue to ₹698.7 crore in Q2FY27. The precision engineering division, Eigen, saw 50% growth, driving capacity expansion plans.

headline: Palm Jewels open offer at ₹24.14 per share
summary: Acquirers launch mandatory open offer for 26% equity in Palm Jewels at ₹24.14 per share, following a 43.36% stake purchase from existing promoters.

headline: Shukra Medtech to raise ₹648 crore via preferential issue
summary: Shukra Medtech plans a preferential issue of 6 crore shares at ₹108 to promoter Parshva Texchem. Board meeting scheduled for Dec 2, 2026.

headline: Cipla secures FDA approval for generic Flovent HFA
summary: Cipla and Teva receive FDA approval for the first generic Flovent HFA in 110 mcg and 220 mcg strengths. The product targets a $350 million US market.

headline: Radico Khaitan launches Rampur Jugalbandi #7 and #8
summary: Radico Khaitan launches the final two expressions of its Rampur Jugalbandi series in India. The limited edition, priced at ₹50,000, marks a strategic push into luxury spirits.
